# QYL0105: Manual span recommended

| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Complex async patterns like Task.WhenAll, Parallel.ForEach, multiple awaits, or ConfigureAwait(false) may not be fully captured by auto-instrumentation. Consider using manual Activity.StartActivity() to create explicit child spans for parallel operations, ensuring each branch of execution is properly traced.
